description: Remove a sitemap from a property in Search Console. This is a DESTRUCTIVE write action: it deregisters the sitemap (it does not delete the file from your server, but Google stops tracking it). Requires the full webmasters OAuth scope.

feedpath.description: Full URL of the sitemap to remove, e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml.

site_url.description: The Search Console property. Use the exact form shown by gsc_list_sites: a Domain property is 'sc-domain:example.com'; a URL-prefix property is the full origin with a trailing slash, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

name: gsc_delete_sitemap
title: Delete a sitemap
